messages:
nora: Hey folks — opened PR #2521: 'SDK snippets & migration notes for Hosted->Dedicated' ready for review. Preview: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-2521. @liam for tech, @rob for style. CI shows linkcheck + vale + markdownlint failures.

ci-bot: CI summary for PR #2521 — failed checks: linkcheck, vale, markdownlint. Use `/retest` to rerun after fixes.

nora: Pasting CI failures:
```
LINKCHECK FAIL: /docs/migration/hosted-to-dedicated.md -> broken link to https://partners.redwood-inference.com/old-guide (404)
VALE FAIL: docs/migration/hosted-to-dedicated.md:22 — VALE[Bias] 'simply' flagged (avoid subjective adverbs)
MARKDOWNLINT WARN: docs/migration/hosted-to-dedicated.md: sdk snippet fence has trailing spaces
```

liam: I'll replace the external partner link with our internal KB and drop the paragraph that referenced the partner page. I'll also add a short networking note so users aren't left hanging.

rob: I'll remove 'simply' and any other marketing-y words, and fix the code fence trailing spaces. Quick copy edit only.

nora: If you push commits will preview rebuild automatically?

docs-bot: Pull request updated — new commit a1c9f2 by liam. Docs preview queued: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-2521

ci-bot: Docs preview results — linkcheck PASS, markdownlint PASS, vale FAIL (1 rule).

rob: The remaining Vale rule is a Clarity hit: docs/migration/hosted-to-dedicated.md:58 — 'wordy sentence' flagged. I trimmed it and rephrased for directness. Pushing now.

docs-bot: Pull request updated — new commit c3d4b7 by rob. Docs preview: build passed — all checks green.

nora: All green. Plan to merge in the 11:00 PT docs window unless anyone objects. Note: this changes SDK snippets — they are non-breaking but pinned in some downstream repos. I'll add a note in the PR description with the KB cross-ref and mention the snippet PINs.

liam: Tech LGTM — no functional change to code samples.

rob: Style LGTM.

nora: Merged (squash) at 11:05 PT. PR summary: docs(migration): add Hosted->Dedicated migration guide, update SDK snippets, replace broken external link. KB: https://kb.redwood-inference.com/migration/hosted-to-dedicated

liam: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up in the downstream repo channel about snippet pins. End thread.
